# SharpBid Estimating

> Construction quantity takeoffs and estimating support for specialty
> subcontractors. Based in Metro Vancouver (Vancouver, BC), serving
> subcontractors across Canada. All work is digital.

## What we do

SharpBid measures quantities off construction drawings so a specialty
subcontractor can price the work with their own unit rates. We count; you
price. We do not sell a pricing database and we do not bid work ourselves.

Behind the work: 15+ years of senior estimating experience on Metro Vancouver
multifamily, mixed-use and commercial projects, both wood-frame and concrete.
No juniors, nothing farmed out. CCDC-fluent.

## Trades covered

- Drywall & steel stud takeoffs — https://sharpbid.ca/drywall-steel-stud-takeoffs
- Acoustic ceiling (ACT) takeoffs — https://sharpbid.ca/acoustic-ceiling-takeoffs
- Flooring takeoffs — https://sharpbid.ca/flooring-takeoffs
- Painting takeoffs — https://sharpbid.ca/painting-takeoffs
- Glazing takeoffs, Div 08 only: curtain wall, storefront, windows, glass — https://sharpbid.ca/glazing-takeoffs
- Roofing & building envelope takeoffs: roofing, cladding, insulation, air/vapour barrier, rainscreen — https://sharpbid.ca/roofing-envelope-takeoffs
- Misc metals takeoffs (Div 05) — https://sharpbid.ca/misc-metals-takeoffs
- Concrete & formwork takeoffs, foundations through high-rise cast-in-place — https://sharpbid.ca/concrete-formwork-takeoffs
- Wood-frame framing takeoffs, in two tiers — https://sharpbid.ca/framing-takeoffs

Coverage spans most CSI MasterFormat divisions.

## What we do not do

- Mechanical and electrical (no Div 21–28 MEP) — this is excluded, not "on request".
- Engineering: structural design, member sizing, thermal modelling, connection design,
  shop drawings. Those are not takeoffs.
- We do not price the work by default. Price placeholders are an optional add-on.

## Service area

Vancouver, BC is home base. Work is delivered digitally to subcontractors
anywhere in Canada — drawings link in, workbook comes back.

## Turnaround

- Fixed written quote within 4 business hours of receiving drawings.
- Single-trade takeoffs: next business day standard.
- Same-day rush: +50%.
- One revision round and bid-period addenda are included.

## Guarantee

On time or 50% off. Addenda that change scope reset the delivery date in
writing.

## Deliverable

Every takeoff arrives as:

1. An Excel quantity workbook, organized to CSI MasterFormat or the client's
   own cost codes.
2. Colour-coded marked-up PDF plans, measured in On-Screen Takeoff and
   Bluebeam Revu.
3. An assumptions & exclusions page.

Optional add-ons: price placeholders (+15%), quote template (+$150).

A downloadable sample workbook (a fictitious 3-storey office TI) is at
https://sharpbid.ca/downloads/SharpBid-Sample-Takeoff-Flooring.xlsx

Takeoffs are delivered in the units the client bids in — metric or imperial.

## Pricing (starting prices, CAD)

- Single-trade finish takeoff (flooring, painting, drywall & steel stud): $450
- Acoustic ceiling (ACT) takeoff: $450
- Concrete & formwork, low-rise / small site: $500
- Concrete & formwork, high-rise cast-in-place: quoted per project (needs lead time)
- Misc metals / Div 05: $600
- Roofing & building envelope: $600
- Framing — wall & sheathing areas: $600 (no lumber piece counts at this tier)
- Glazing — Div 08 curtain wall, storefront, windows: $900
- Bid leveling / scope-gap analysis: $600
- Framing — full lumber breakdown: $1,500 (quoted per project)
- Change-order & claim quantity checks: $150/hr, 3-hour minimum
- Minimum engagement: $450
- Retainers: from $1,500/month

## Tools

On-Screen Takeoff and Bluebeam Revu for measurement. Excel for the workbook.
Deliverables open anywhere — no special software needed at the client's end.
